prompt: Who is the first Republican president of the United States to serve non-consecutive terms?
answer: Donald J. Trump was the first Republican president to serve non-consecutive terms. He served as the 45th president from 2017–2021 and again as the 47th president beginning in 2025. Grover Cleveland was the first president overall to do so, but he was a Democrat.
